This is a fully remote role based in Brazil, and you’ll collaborate closely with teams across the U.S. and Brazil. Your work will follow Brasilia Standard Time, and you’ll be hired as a CLT contract employee with compensation in BRL.

title: Representante Comercial (RCA) | Hunter Região Nordeste
description:
Sobre a vaga


Mobiis

Modelo de trabalho: Remoto (com atuação externa na região)

Região Nordeste



Sobre a vaga


Buscamos Representantes Comerciais (RCA) com forte perfil hunter , foco em prospecção ativa, abertura de mercado e fechamento de novos contratos , para expandir a presença da Mobiis em diferentes regiões do Brasil.

Este profissional será um dos principais vetores de crescimento da companhia , levando ao mercado o ecossistema SaaS da Mobiis — soluções que transformam desafios logísticos complexos em eficiência operacional, redução de custos e ganho de escala , com foco em receita recorrente (MRR) e serviços.


Missão da função


Atuar de forma estratégica e autônoma na prospecção e aquisição de novos clientes, construindo um pipeline saudável e previsível, convertendo oportunidades em contratos e fortalecendo a presença da Mobiis no mercado logístico.


Reporte e interfaces


  • Reporta-se a: Gerente de Vendas da Mobiis
  • Interage com: Pré-Vendas, Marketing, Customer Success e time Comercial Interno


Principais responsabilidades


Prospecção ativa e abertura de mercado (Hunter)


  • Prospectar novos clientes de forma ativa (outbound): embarcadores, operadores logísticos, indústrias, distribuidores e varejo.
  • Mapear contas-alvo, decisores e influenciadores na região de atuação.
  • Atuar por múltiplos canais: telefone, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, e-mail e visitas presenciais.
  • Construir, gerir e manter pipeline próprio, contínuo e previsível.


Venda consultiva e condução do ciclo comercial


  • Conduzir reuniões de diagnóstico aprofundado (AS-IS / TO-BE).
  • Identificar dores operacionais, gargalos logísticos e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Apresentar de forma consultiva as soluções do portfólio Mobiis.
  • Elaborar e conduzir propostas comerciais envolvendo MRR, implantação, integrações e serviços.


Negociação e fechamento


  • Conduzir negociações com autonomia, respeitando as políticas comerciais da Mobiis.
  • Atuar com forte foco em fechamento, previsibilidade e geração de nova receita.
  • Garantir transição estruturada do cliente para os times de Implantação e Customer Success após o fechamento.


Gestão comercial e inteligência de mercado


  • Manter organização do funil de vendas e reportes periódicos de pipeline e resultados.
  • Monitorar concorrência, práticas comerciais e tendências do mercado regional.
  • Reportar oportunidades, riscos e insights estratégicos à liderança comercial.
  • Identificar e desenvolver potenciais parcerias regionais.


Metas e indicadores (referência)


  • Novos contratos fechados (MRR e serviços).
  • Volume mensal de oportunidades qualificadas geradas.
  • Taxa de conversão e ticket médio.
  • Ciclo de vendas e previsibilidade do pipeline.
  • Metas definidas em conjunto com o Gerente de Vendas, considerando o potencial da região.


Requisitos obrigatórios


  • Experiência comprovada em vendas B2B outbound (perfil hunter).
  • Histórico consistente em abertura de novos clientes e desenvolvimento de mercado.
  • Vivência em vendas consultivas e negociação com decisores.
  • Perfil empreendedor, autônomo, disciplinado e orientado a resultados.
  • Excelente comunicação, organização e capacidade de autogestão.
  • Carro próprio e disponibilidade para deslocamentos e visitas comerciais.
  • Residência no polo regional de atuação ou proximidades.


Diferenciais (alto peso)


  • Conhecimento em soluções alinhadas ao portfólio da Mobiis, como:
  • TMS (Transportation Management System)
  • WMS (Warehouse Management System)
  • DMS (Delivery Management System)
  • YMS (Yard Management System)
  • Roteirização e otimização logística
  • Plataformas SaaS para logística, transporte e supply chain
  • Relacionamento ativo com embarcadores, operadores logísticos, indústrias ou distribuidores.
  • Experiência em vendas de software SaaS e contratos recorrentes (MRR).
  • Conhecimento de indicadores logísticos (OTIF, custo de frete, produtividade, nível de serviço).


Exclusividade e conflito de interesses


  • Não há exigência de exclusividade.
  • O RCA poderá representar outras empresas, desde que não concorrentes diretas ou indiretas da Mobiis.
  • Eventuais conflitos de interesse serão analisados previamente pela Mobiis.
  • Território de atuação definido para organização comercial e proteção de oportunidades.


Modelo de remuneração


  • Modelo comissionado , com comissões atrativas sobre:
  • Receita recorrente (MRR)
  • Serviços (implantação, integrações, projetos e upsell inicial)
  • Possibilidade de ganhos recorrentes enquanto os clientes permanecerem ativos.
  • Percentuais, regras e condições definidos em contrato de representação comercial.


Suporte da Mobiis


  • Onboarding comercial e técnico sobre portfólio, mercado e posicionamento.
  • Materiais de vendas, apresentações e apoio do time de Pré-Vendas.
  • Acompanhamento próximo do Gerente de Vendas.
  • Marca consolidada, soluções robustas e alto potencial de crescimento.

Este profissional será um dos principais vetores de crescimento da companhia , levando ao mercado o ecossistema SaaS da Mobiis — soluções que transformam desafios logísticos complexos em eficiência operacional, redução de custos e ganho de escala , com foco em receita recorrente (MRR) e serviços.


Missão da função


Atuar de forma estratégica e autônoma na prospecção e aquisição de novos clientes, construindo um pipeline saudável e previsível, convertendo oportunidades em contratos e fortalecendo a presença da Mobiis no mercado logístico.


Reporte e interfaces


  • Reporta-se a: Gerente de Vendas da Mobiis
  • Interage com: Pré-Vendas, Marketing, Customer Success e time Comercial Interno


Principais responsabilidades


Prospecção ativa e abertura de mercado (Hunter)


  • Prospectar novos clientes de forma ativa (outbound): embarcadores, operadores logísticos, indústrias, distribuidores e varejo.
  • Mapear contas-alvo, decisores e influenciadores na região de atuação.
  • Atuar por múltiplos canais: telefone, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, e-mail e visitas presenciais.
  • Construir, gerir e manter pipeline próprio, contínuo e previsível.


Venda consultiva e condução do ciclo comercial


  • Conduzir reuniões de diagnóstico aprofundado (AS-IS / TO-BE).
  • Identificar dores operacionais, gargalos logísticos e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Apresentar de forma consultiva as soluções do portfólio Mobiis.
  • Elaborar e conduzir propostas comerciais envolvendo MRR, implantação, integrações e serviços.


Negociação e fechamento


  • Conduzir negociações com autonomia, respeitando as políticas comerciais da Mobiis.
  • Atuar com forte foco em fechamento, previsibilidade e geração de nova receita.
  • Garantir transição estruturada do cliente para os times de Implantação e Customer Success após o fechamento.


Gestão comercial e inteligência de mercado


  • Manter organização do funil de vendas e reportes periódicos de pipeline e resultados.
  • Monitorar concorrência, práticas comerciais e tendências do mercado regional.
  • Reportar oportunidades, riscos e insights estratégicos à liderança comercial.
  • Identificar e desenvolver potenciais parcerias regionais.


Metas e indicadores (referência)


  • Novos contratos fechados (MRR e serviços).
  • Volume mensal de oportunidades qualificadas geradas.
  • Taxa de conversão e ticket médio.
  • Ciclo de vendas e previsibilidade do pipeline.
  • Metas definidas em conjunto com o Gerente de Vendas, considerando o potencial da região.


Requisitos obrigatórios


  • Experiência comprovada em vendas B2B outbound (perfil hunter).
  • Histórico consistente em abertura de novos clientes e desenvolvimento de mercado.
  • Vivência em vendas consultivas e negociação com decisores.
  • Perfil empreendedor, autônomo, disciplinado e orientado a resultados.
  • Excelente comunicação, organização e capacidade de autogestão.
  • Carro próprio e disponibilidade para deslocamentos e visitas comerciais.
  • Residência no polo regional de atuação ou proximidades.


Diferenciais (alto peso)


  • Conhecimento em soluções alinhadas ao portfólio da Mobiis, como:
  • TMS (Transportation Management System)
  • WMS (Warehouse Management System)
  • DMS (Delivery Management System)
  • YMS (Yard Management System)
  • Roteirização e otimização logística
  • Plataformas SaaS para logística, transporte e supply chain
  • Relacionamento ativo com embarcadores, operadores logísticos, indústrias ou distribuidores.
  • Experiência em vendas de software SaaS e contratos recorrentes (MRR).
  • Conhecimento de indicadores logísticos (OTIF, custo de frete, produtividade, nível de serviço).


Exclusividade e conflito de interesses


  • Não há exigência de exclusividade.
  • O RCA poderá representar outras empresas, desde que não concorrentes diretas ou indiretas da Mobiis.
  • Eventuais conflitos de interesse serão analisados previamente pela Mobiis.
  • Território de atuação definido para organização comercial e proteção de oportunidades.


Modelo de remuneração


  • Modelo comissionado , com comissões atrativas sobre:
  • Receita recorrente (MRR)
  • Serviços (implantação, integrações, projetos e upsell inicial)
  • Possibilidade de ganhos recorrentes enquanto os clientes permanecerem ativos.
  • Percentuais, regras e condições definidos em contrato de representação comercial.


Suporte da Mobiis


  • Onboarding comercial e técnico sobre portfólio, mercado e posicionamento.
  • Materiais de vendas, apresentações e apoio do time de Pré-Vendas.
  • Acompanhamento próximo do Gerente de Vendas.
  • Marca consolidada, soluções robustas e alto potencial de crescimento.

title: Agentic AI Developer - Agentes de Inteligência Artificial
description:
Sobre a TRUTIME

A TRUTIME não está contratando um desenvolvedor.

Estamos abrindo espaço para alguém assumir controle de um sistema operacional de agentes autônomos , projetado para decidir e agir antes do mercado. Enquanto 99% das empresas ainda usam IA para responder quando alguém chama, nós fazemos o oposto.


Nossos agentes iniciam. Agem. Executam.


O problema que atacamos é brutalmente simples: Empresas perdem dinheiro porque demoram em responder., demoram para decidir, demoram para agir. E demora não escala.


A TRUTIME existe para substituir atraso por infraestrutura. Com código rodando em produção.


O que você vai construir aqui

Aqui você não vai “experimentar IA”. Você vai operar IA em ambiente real de negócio .

Na prática, você irá:

  • Construir agentes autônomos orientados a ação , (- conversa + ação)
  • Projetar sistemas right-time
  • Orquestrar agentes que operam 24/7 em canais reais (voz, WhatsApp, sistemas comerciais)
  • Definir arquitetura, limites de autonomia, fallback e controle de risco
  • Criar loops de decisão baseados em contexto, estado e prioridade
  • Ver seu código criar receita real , todos os dias


Na TRUTIME, seu código fala primeiro no mercado.


O NÍVEL:

O nível é alto e a responsabilidade também.

Autonomia é pré-requisito.


Se você é bom, isso vai te atrair. Se você é excelente, isso vai te incomodar, até você participar.


Depois de entender que tempo é a única vantagem que não pode ser copiada , trabalhar na construção de qualquer outro tipo de sistema operacional não vai fazer sentido.


A TRUTIME NÃO É PARA TODO MUNDO.

É para quem vai construir algo que o mercado ainda não sabe pedir.


Stack e Arquitetura (o que esperamos que você domine ou saiba decidir)

Atuando como especialista em agentic commerce , o stack esperado gira em torno de:


LINGUAGENS E RUNTIME

  • Python (core de agentes, decisão, orquestração)
  • Node.js (integrações, tempo real, pipelines de comunicação)
  • Experiência com ambientes assíncronos e concorrentes

LLMs e IA

  • Anthropic / OpenAI API ou equivalentes (LLMs como motores cognitivos)
  • Prompting estruturado + function calling + tool usage
  • State management para agentes (memória curta, média e longa)
  • Avaliação e observabilidade de agentes (não só accuracy)

AGENTIC SYSTEMS

  • Orquestração multi-agente
  • Definição clara de autonomia, limites e exceções
  • Sistemas orientados a eventos e decisão
  • Design de fallback humano e degradação controlada

INFRA

  • APIs REST e/ou WebSockets
  • Cloud (AWS)
  • Serverless quando fizer sentido. Stateful quando for necessário
  • Filas, jobs, retries, idempotência

DADOS E INTEGRAÇÕES

  • CRMs, ERPs, sistemas de vendas ou comunicação
  • Logs, métricas e rastreabilidade de decisão
  • Análise de performance baseada em impacto de negócio


O que diferencia um candidato forte

  • Já construiu algo que operou sem supervisão constante
  • Entende que agente bom não é o que “fala bonito”, é o que avança no pipeline de vendas
  • Consegue pensar arquitetura antes de código
  • Não tem apego dogmático a frameworks
  • Consegue discutir trade-offs entre velocidade, risco e impacto


Modelo de trabalho

  • Full-time
  • Remoto
  • Alta autonomia
  • Alta cobrança
  • Zero burocracia
  • Proximidade direta com estratégia de negócio.

title: Desenvolvedor Backend Node.js Sênior
description:
Quem somos

A DEXIAN, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como DEXIAN, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


*O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A DEXIAN está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!


O que estamos Buscando?

Desenvolvedor Back-End para participar da refatoração de demandas estruturais, com foco na revisão de processos e sistemas de integração e disponibilização de dados, desenvolvendo a solução tecnológica considerando escalabilidade, disponibilidade, segurança e monitoria. Atender as necessidades das áreas de negócios, observando os padrões e as diretivas corporativas. Disseminar conhecimento com seus pares, documentando, comunicando e viabilizando o acesso às informações. Ter atitude de dono, aplicando visão forense e buscando as melhores práticas com foco nos resultados e entregas. Levantar estimativas para as soluções propostas, com bom raciocínio lógico, senso crítico, organização, proatividade e boa capacidade de trabalhar em equipe.


O que você precisa ter:

• Experiência em ambientes de nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) e desenvolvimento em NodeJs (JavaScript, desejável TypeScript), com testes unitários e de integração e documentação de APIs REST e Async API.

• Atuação no desenvolvimento de microsserviços, arquiteturas orientadas a serviços e eventos (SOA/EDA), com implementação de tracing, logging, containers e CI/CD.

• Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais, versionamento de código, NPM/Yarn e metodologias ágeis (Scrum e Kanban).

• Experiência em sustentação de aplicações, monitoria, troubleshooting, melhoria contínua e repasse para equipes de suporte.

• Diferencial para Java (Spring Boot e Spring Batch), Scala, Python, Kubernetes, mensageria (Kafka, RabbitMQ, Service Bus, SQS) e protocolos HTTP/HTTPS, AMQP e TCP.

• Vivência com segurança da informação (LGPD/GDPR), ambientes financeiros, SaaS/DaaS, integração de dados e ferramentas de transferência de arquivos.


Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
*Please submit your CV in English only.


Location: Remote – based near Sao Paolo, Brazil


POSITION PURPOSE/MISSION:


As a Customer Success Manager, you serve as the vital connection between our company and our

customers. The primary goal of this role is to ensure that our clients reach their desired outcomes

through the successful use and adoption of our software solutions. By cultivating trusted relationships, proactively guiding clients, and offering expert support, you directly contribute to their satisfaction, loyalty, and long-term success. This role is essential to ensuring that our customers see measurable value, continue their partnership with us, and are well-positioned to expand their use of our offerings.


Your ability to manage customer expectations, resolve issues efficiently, and provide actionable insights will play a key part in building strong, ongoing relationships. This position also requires an in-depth understanding of SaaS solutions and insurance operations, as well as a collaborative mindset suited for working in a globally distributed, remote-first team environment.


This role will have secondary responsibilities to assist with pre-sales activities including but not limited to: gather, understand and translate customer’s technical requirements, bridge communications between technical and non-technical teams, assist or conduct product demos, create technical documentation, assist or complete RFP’s, support FRISS’ implementation teams & other potential duties.



DESCRIPTION OF ACTIVITIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:


  • Customer Relationship Management

Build and nurture strong, long-term relationships with customers by serving as their trusted

advisor. Regularly check in with key stakeholders to understand their experience and align on

expectations and needs.


  • Proactive Engagement

Maintain regular contact with customers through scheduled calls, emails, and success planning

sessions. Ensure that their goals are defined and met, anticipate challenges, and propose

proactive solutions to maximize satisfaction.


  • Performance Monitoring

Continuously monitor customer usage, health scores, and performance data to assess how the

product is delivering value. Use insights to identify areas of concern or opportunity and

intervene early when needed.


  • Product Enhancements

Collect feedback from customer interactions and communicate relevant insights to the product

development team. Help inform future product enhancements by representing the voice of the

customer.


  • Renewals and Upselling

Take ownership of contract renewals, maintaining strong relationships that support ongoing engagement. Identify and pursue upsell opportunities where additional features or services can deliver added value to the customer.


  • Customer Training

Support new customers during onboarding by guiding them through our processes and helping them become self-sufficient. Provide training and support to ensure they can use our software confidently and effectively.


  • Internal Collaboration

Work closely with the Professional Services & Sales team to ensure a seamless handover from pre-sale to post-sale. Provide background on customer expectations and align on strategy for long-term success. And other duties assigned.


JOB SKILLS:


Success in this role depends on both soft skills and the ability to operate effectively in a digital, global

environment.


Must Haves:

  • Insurance Expertise

Deep subject matter expertise in Insurance is a non-negotiable for this role. The CSM must be able to communicate with clients in their native language (insurance), understand their needs and deliver consultative insights aligned with FRISS’ product value


Language Skills

  • This role requires tri-lingual language skills:

Native-level Portuguese to serve clients in Brazil; fluent in Spanish to serve clients throughout LATAM; and professional working level in English to communicate within FRISS.


Nice to Haves:

  • Customer Focus and Engagement

You are passionate about helping customers succeed, and you consistently strive to understand

their needs and exceed their expectations.


  • Business & Analytical Insights

You understand how your customers operate and how to align our solutions with their business

objectives. You are analytically inclined and can demonstrate FRISS’ value through storytelling

and analytical insights.


  • Technical Proficiency

You are comfortable using CRM systems, customer success platforms, and other relevant SaaS tools to manage your workflow and customer data effectively. · Global Perspective You thrive in an international, remote-first work environment and can communicate and collaborate across geographies and cultures with ease.

title: Remote Biomedical Informatics SME - 58854
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview:

We are seeking highly skilled Biomedical Informatics Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to join our team in developing rigorous, high-quality evaluation questions designed to assess and challenge advanced AI models. The primary objective is to create benchmark questions that test the boundaries of AI capabilities across diverse bioinformatics domains.

This role requires deep technical expertise combined with the ability to craft precise, unambiguous questions with well-defined evaluations. The ideal candidate will possess not only strong theoretical knowledge but also practical experience in designing assessment materials that have deterministic, verifiable outcomes.


Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop challenging bioinformatics coding questions that push the limits of AI model capabilities.
  • Create automated, coding-based evaluations with unit tests that objectively verify correctness.
  • Build comprehensive evaluation rubrics with 7–10 distinct criteria for each bioinformatics question.
  • Ensure every question is self-contained, well-defined, and completely unambiguous, including all domain rules and edge cases.
  • Develop problems where there is exactly one correct answer or outcome that can be deterministically validated.
  • Translate theoretical bioinformatics concepts into concrete, measurable outputs.
  • Enforce performance requirements with explicit constraints and tests to prevent inefficient or brute-force solutions.


Required Qualifications:

Educational Background

  • Master's degree of experience in biomedical data processing and interpretation.
  • Ongoing PhD with 3+ years of experience in biomedical data processing and interpretation.
  • PhD (completed) in Biomedical Informatics, Bioinformatics, Computational Biology or a closely related field (preferred).


Technical and other skills

  • Strong proficiency in biomedical data processing, analysis, and interpretation , including working with large‑scale datasets.
  • Experience with bioinformatics tools and pipelines (e.g., NGS workflows, multi‑omics, etc.).
  • Solid programming skills in Python / R
  • Experience working in Linux/Unix , Docker and version control.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills for working in interdisciplinary research teams


Domain Expertise Requirements

Candidates must demonstrate deep, expert-level knowledge in at least TWO (2) of the following five core bioinformatics domains:

1. Biomedical Image Processing

  • Processing of Radiology imaging: CT, MRI, PET/SPECT, Ultrasound imaging
  • Automating cell counting, identifying cell types, and analyzing tissue structures in pathology slides
  • Computational segmentation and boundary inference
  • Medical image formation, reconstruction & enhancement
  • Noise modeling and statistical denoising
  • Image sampling theory and resolution limits
  • Intensity standardization and harmonization
  • Geometric transformations and spatial calibration
  • Multi-modal image registration and alignment
  • Morphological and topological shape analysis
  • Quantitative imaging feature extraction
  • Fusing data from different modalities (MRI, PET, Genomics) for a comprehensive view to tailor treatments
  • pattern recognition and predictive modeling

2. Biomedical Signal Processing

  • Cardiovascular/hemodynamic signals (ECG, PPG, BP, HRV, etc)
  • Neural/brain electrical signals (EEG, EP/ERP; seizure/cognitive analysis)
  • Neuromuscular/motor signals (EMG, motor unit decomposition; prosthetics/rehab)
  • Ocular/visual system signals (EOG, blink/saccade analysis)
  • Respiratory signals (airflow, effort; sleep/disordered breathing)
  • Nonlinear, Statistical, and Adaptive Signal Analysis
  • Multichannel, Spatial, and Connectivity Signal Analysis
  • Machine Learning and Data‑Driven Biomedical Signal Analysis
  • Clinical Monitoring, Wearable, and Translational Signal Processing

3. Molecular & Omics based Personalized Medicine

  • Omics based risk / disease prediction (GWAS, PRS, bulk, single‑cell RNA‑seq, proteins / metabolite signatures associated with diseases)
  • Risk Prediction and Prognosis Modeling
  • Molecular patient subtyping
  • Liquid Biopsy and Circulating Biomarkers (ctDNA, cfRNA/miRNA, MRD, etc.)
  • Causal Inference & Mechanistic Inference (ATE/CATE, Trial emulation and counterfactual modeling)
  • Cross‑modal data fusion (omics + EHR + imaging / signals)
  • Longitudinal Patient Modeling and Disease Progression
  • Patient Stratification and Subtyping (molecular subtypes, endotypes)
  • Electronic Health Records and Clinical Data Science

4. Drug Discovery & Repurposing

  • Treatment response prediction
  • Structure-based drug design (Molecular docking, binding site analysis, Virtual screening workflow)
  • Protein structure analysis (PDB/mmCIF handling)
  • Chemoinformatics ( Ligand-based screening, molecular fingerprinting, 2D/3D data handling and chemical space analysis)
  • QSAR & ADMET Modeling
  • Drug–target interaction prediction
  • Drug sensitivity prediction in disease models
  • Repurposing via omics/network associations
  • Predictive Modeling for Drug Discovery Molecular Dynamics Simulation of Biomolecules (QM, DFT, stability, reactivity, PCA analysis )

5. Software / Utilities

  • Tool installation & environment management (docker/conda/pip)
  • Format conversion/validation (FASTA/FASTQ, BAM/VCF, PDB)
  • GUI-driven analysis workflows (step-by-step runs)
  • Workflow automation (scripts wrapping GUI tools)
  • Visualization tools (genome browsers, 3D viewers)
  • Container/VM execution and troubleshooting
  • Batch processing and report generation
  • Pipeline interoperability checks
  • Reproducibility packaging (configs, manifests)
  • Debugging typical bioinformatics tool errors

6. Regulatory Science and Clinical Policies

  • FDA/EMA regulatory pathways
  • Clinical Practice Guidelines & Standards of Care (e.g., NCCN, AHA, etc.)
  • Diagnostic Biomarker & Therapeutic Use Constraints
  • Medical Scenario Reasoning (case vignettes, Differential diagnosis)
  • Data & Content Compliance
  • Ethical Use, Safety, and Harm Prevention
  • Model Use Governance & Auditability
  • Policy‑Aligned Language & Communication
  • Clinical validation and cohort generalization
  • Privacy‑preserving learning


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : At least 30 hours per week. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 2 months; (expected start date is next week)


Evaluation Process:

  • Take home Assessment on Biomedical Informatics (2-6 hours)
  • Delivery discussion(15-30mins)


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

Mobiis

Buscamos Representantes Comerciais (RCA) com forte perfil hunter , foco em prospecção ativa, abertura de mercado e fechamento de novos contratos , para expandir a presença da Mobiis em diferentes regiões do Brasil.

Atuar de forma estratégica e autônoma na prospecção e aquisição de novos clientes, construindo um pipeline saudável e previsível, convertendo oportunidades em contratos e fortalecendo a presença da Mobiis no mercado logístico.

Principais responsabilidades


Prospecção ativa e abertura de mercado (Hunter)

Negociação e fechamento


  • Conduzir negociações com autonomia, respeitando as políticas comerciais da Mobiis.
  • Atuar com forte foco em fechamento, previsibilidade e geração de nova receita.
  • Garantir transição estruturada do cliente para os times de Implantação e Customer Success após o fechamento.

  • Manter organização do funil de vendas e reportes periódicos de pipeline e resultados.
  • Monitorar concorrência, práticas comerciais e tendências do mercado regional.
  • Reportar oportunidades, riscos e insights estratégicos à liderança comercial.
  • Identificar e desenvolver potenciais parcerias regionais.

  • Novos contratos fechados (MRR e serviços).
  • Volume mensal de oportunidades qualificadas geradas.
  • Taxa de conversão e ticket médio.
  • Ciclo de vendas e previsibilidade do pipeline.
  • Metas definidas em conjunto com o Gerente de Vendas, considerando o potencial da região.


Requisitos obrigatórios


  • Experiência comprovada em vendas B2B outbound (perfil hunter).
  • Histórico consistente em abertura de novos clientes e desenvolvimento de mercado.
  • Vivência em vendas consultivas e negociação com decisores.
  • Perfil empreendedor, autônomo, disciplinado e orientado a resultados.
  • Excelente comunicação, organização e capacidade de autogestão.
  • Carro próprio e disponibilidade para deslocamentos e visitas comerciais.
  • Residência no polo regional de atuação ou proximidades.


Diferenciais (alto peso)


  • Conhecimento em soluções alinhadas ao portfólio da Mobiis, como:
  • TMS (Transportation Management System)
  • WMS (Warehouse Management System)
  • DMS (Delivery Management System)
  • YMS (Yard Management System)
  • Roteirização e otimização logística
  • Plataformas SaaS para logística, transporte e supply chain
  • Relacionamento ativo com embarcadores, operadores logísticos, indústrias ou distribuidores.
  • Experiência em vendas de software SaaS e contratos recorrentes (MRR).
  • Conhecimento de indicadores logísticos (OTIF, custo de frete, produtividade, nível de serviço).


Exclusividade e conflito de interesses


  • Não há exigência de exclusividade.
  • O RCA poderá representar outras empresas, desde que não concorrentes diretas ou indiretas da Mobiis.
  • Eventuais conflitos de interesse serão analisados previamente pela Mobiis.
  • Território de atuação definido para organização comercial e proteção de oportunidades.


Modelo de remuneração


  • Modelo comissionado , com comissões atrativas sobre:
  • Receita recorrente (MRR)
  • Serviços (implantação, integrações, projetos e upsell inicial)
  • Possibilidade de ganhos recorrentes enquanto os clientes permanecerem ativos.
  • Percentuais, regras e condições definidos em contrato de representação comercial.


Suporte da Mobiis


  • Onboarding comercial e técnico sobre portfólio, mercado e posicionamento.
  • Materiais de vendas, apresentações e apoio do time de Pré-Vendas.
  • Acompanhamento próximo do Gerente de Vendas.
  • Marca consolidada, soluções robustas e alto potencial de crescimento.

title: Project Analyst (Petroleum Exploration & Production)
description:
Project Analyst (Petroleum Exploration & Production)

Curitiba/PR, Brazil


Position type: Full-Time, in-person

Reports to: Regional Director, IPA-LA

Date posted: February 11, 2026

Closing date: Open until filled


Introduction

Are you interested in how the oil and gas Exploration & Production (E&P) world is transitioning? Do you love making connections and solving puzzles or problems? Are you detailed and focused, yet you also have broad interests and ideas and excellent communication skills? Do you enjoy analytical research work while also being comfortable client-facing?


If so, please apply as a Project Analyst – Petroleum Exploration & Production in IPA’s Latin America office! The Project Analyst will lead evaluations and consulting for major energy players to help them improve the effectiveness of their capital projects.


About the Role

Independent Project Analysis (IPA) has an opening position in our Latin America office (located in Curitiba/PR, Brazil) for a Project Analyst – Petroleum Exploration & Production . The candidate should have a proven track record working on capital projects or analyzing project feasibility in the upstream oil & gas market. Candidates are required to have strong analytical skills, intellectual curiosity, and a desire to contribute as a thought leader. Aptitude for and demonstrated skills to be a successful analyst include your ability to connect in real life with the data and vice versa, to know when to ask more questions and when to just listen, as well as to be self-motivated to learn and thrive.


IPA’s client portfolio includes world-leading companies in both the heavy and light industries around the world. IPA has offices in the United States, the United Kingdom, The Netherlands, Australia, Brazil, and Singapore; as such, major industry leaders globally rely on us to assess the health of their capital project systems and provide recommendations to improve their performance. IPA evaluates hundreds of capital projects every year, developing very complete technical, business, and people histories from their front-end through early operation. These histories become the data we use to find what works and what does not work in capital projects. The IPA project databases are unique and the most comprehensive sources of capital project experience in existence. IPA also takes a leading role in empirical research into the drivers of better projects and project systems using our extensive databases of past project performance.


Responsibilities

General responsibilities of the role include:

  • Working directly with capital project teams and project organizations of major E&P companies to improve business competitiveness
  • Interfacing with clients to collect and analyze technical, cost, schedule, and project management data
  • Writing reports with insight and a customer focus
  • Delivering verbal feedback and public presentations
  • Conducting research on the drivers of project success or failure using proprietary databases and statistics


Day in the Life

Responsibilities of the Project Analyst – Petroleum Exploration & Production role include:

  • Interfacing directly with clients in person to collect project data and uncover areas of risk
  • Applying statistical analysis to quantify your findings
  • Writing reports to provide insight and recommendations for clients
  • Delivering verbal feedback and presentations to technical and business audiences
  • Working directly with capital project teams and project organizations of major E&P companies to improve business competitiveness
  • Conducting research on drivers of project success and failure using IPA’s proprietary databases and statistics


Skills and Qualities

Project Analysts – Petroleum Exploration & Production must have:

  • Demonstrable Portuguese and English language oral and written communication skills; fluency in Spanish is an advantage
  • Solid analytical skills
  • Ability to demonstrate intellectual curiosity and organizational leadership
  • Excellent listening, presentation, and report writing skills with strong attention to detail
  • Strong interpersonal skills to develop and maintain relationships at senior levels with client companies and liaise with people from other cultures
  • Strong work ethic
  • High self-motivation and ability to work independently
  • Positive attitude and willingness to work in a team
  • Ability to work to tight deadlines and under pressure
  • Flexibility in taking on a variety of assignments


Travel

  • This position requires up to 30 percent travel; candidates are required to have proper documentation for necessary business travel
  • Travel will be required primarily within Latin America and is primarily on weekdays


Education and Experience

  • A Master’s degree (preferred) or Bachelor’s degree or the equivalent in engineering, science (physics, chemistry, petroleum, geology), statistics, operations research, economics, or related fields
  • Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience with upstream oil and gas projects
  • Proven record of carrying out independent research or using a variety of statistical methods to analyze large amounts of data


WHY IPA?

For over 35 years, IPA has delivered groundbreaking research and quantitative risk analyses to enhance the value generated by our clients’ capital project systems and meet their obligations for sustainable and safe performance. IPA guides capital‑intensive organizations to establish the right combination of people, work process, and governance to maximize performance across several measures: cost, schedule, safety, operability performance, and carbon reduction. We have a dataset of over 24,000 capital projects as the basis of our work. Our clients are leading companies in the energy, minerals, infrastructure, chemicals, pharmaceutical, and consumer products sectors. IPA is committed to social and ethical responsibility, and all global offices initiate or participate in local charity initiatives to support those in need.


HOW TO APPLY

Applicants should complete the form at and include a cover letter, resume, and salary requirement.

title: Técnico de P&D
description:

title: Analista Sênior de Planejamento Corporativo & Analytics
description:
Vaga: Analista Sênior de Planejamento Corporativo & Analytics

Local: Lapa – São Paulo | Presencial

Nível: Sênior


Se você transforma dados em decisões estratégicas, essa vaga é para você.

No nosso time de Planejamento Corporativo, os dados não são apenas números — são direcionadores de estratégia. Buscamos um(a) Analista Sênior de Planejamento Corporativo & Analytics para apoiar decisões executivas por meio de análises robustas, estruturação de indicadores e fortalecimento da governança da informação.

Essa pessoa terá papel fundamental na consolidação de métricas corporativas, na construção de dashboards executivos e na elevação do nível analítico da organização, atuando de forma transversal com Comercial, Abastecimento, Supply Chain, Finanças e Digital.


Seus desafios no jogo:

• Estruturar e padronizar indicadores corporativos, assegurando alinhamento de regras de negócio entre as áreas;

• Atuar de forma consultiva junto às áreas de negócio, questionando premissas, propondo melhorias e elevando o nível crítico das decisões;

• Conectar informações de diferentes áreas para gerar uma visão corporativa integrada do desempenho da companhia;

• Contribuir para projetos de estruturação e evolução da área de Planejamento & Analytics.


O que esperamos de você:

• Ensino superior completo em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Estatística, Matemática ou áreas correlatas;

• Experiência sólida em Planejamento Corporativo, Planejamento Comercial, FP&A ou áreas analíticas estratégicas;

• Domínio avançado de Excel e Power BI;

• Experiência com SQL (preferencialmente BigQuery ou ambientes analíticos similares);

• Vivência com indicadores de negócio como vendas, margem, CMV, estoque, giro, markdown, forecast, aderência e rentabilidade;

• Forte capacidade analítica e experiência com grandes bases de dados;

• Perfil estruturado, criterioso e orientado à governança de regras de negócio;

• Comunicação clara e segurança para interagir com gerências e diretoria;

• Autonomia, senso de dono e responsabilidade sobre entregas estratégicas;

• Organização e disciplina para atuar com múltiplos projetos e stakeholders;

• Postura colaborativa, com visão corporativa e não departamental;

• Conforto em ambientes dinâmicos e em constante evolução.


⭐ Diferenciais:

• Experiência em varejo, bens de consumo ou ambientes multicanal;

• Vivência em processos de governança e padronização de indicadores corporativos;

• Experiência com planejamento de demanda, abastecimento ou forecast;

• Participação em projetos de estruturação ou reestruturação de áreas analíticas.

title: Senior Finance Business Partner
description:
About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Finance Business Partner to support our rapidly growing Customer Service platform across multiple countries. This role sits at the intersection of finance and operations, acting as a strategic advisor to business leaders while ensuring strong financial governance, scalable processes, and disciplined cost management.


The ideal candidate brings deep Finance BP experience, thrives in fast-paced environments, and demonstrates strong business acumen — particularly within customer-centric or service-driven organizations.


Key Responsibilities

  • Strategic Finance Partnership: Partner closely with the multi-country Customer Service leadership team to drive financial planning, improve decision-making, and embed financial discipline into daily operations.
  • Financial Process Optimization: Design, implement, and continuously improve financial processes, policies, and controls. Provide expert guidance to support sustainable and compliant business growth.
  • Market Expansion Support: Lead financial readiness for launches in new countries or cities by establishing scalable frameworks, ensuring operational continuity, and proactively mitigating financial risks.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Work in close partnership with Accounting, Tax, Treasury, Reporting, and Internal Controls teams to ensure regulatory compliance and alignment with corporate standards.
  • Budgeting & Forecasting Leadership: Own the annual budgeting cycle and rolling forecasts for the Customer Experience (CE) business. Build a robust budget management structure and partner with stakeholders to drive accountability and financial performance.
  • Advanced Financial Analysis: Develop a comprehensive financial analysis framework to evaluate business performance, identify risks and opportunities, and deliver actionable insights — with a strong focus on cost efficiency and operational productivity within customer service environments.
  • Data & Financial Digitalization: Contribute to the evolution of financial systems and digital tools by defining analytical and monitoring requirements that enhance visibility and decision support.


Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
  • Solid experience in Finance Business Partnering or similar strategic finance roles.
  • Proven exposure to multi-country or regional operations .
  • Strong business judgment with the ability to translate financial data into strategic recommendations.
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders.
  • Advanced analytical capabilities and proficiency with financial and data analysis tools.
  • Highly adaptable, proactive, and comfortable operating in dynamic, high-growth environments.
  • Professional fluency in English.
  • Experience managing finance for customer service, contact centers, shared services, or operations-heavy businesses .
  • Background in multinational or high-growth technology, e-commerce, logistics, or platform companies.


Why Join Us

  • Scale with a high-growth global business: Play a key role in supporting rapidly expanding international operations.
  • True business exposure: Operate as a strategic partner with direct impact on operational and financial outcomes.
  • Broad finance scope: Gain hands-on experience across multiple finance disciplines while shaping scalable frameworks for the future.
  • High visibility: Collaborate with senior stakeholders and influence critical business decisions.

title: Senior Key Account Manager
description:
About Us

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to revolutionize food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: \"We help people eat better, live better,\" we're taking innovation to the global stage! Within just one year, Keeta has become an industry leader in Hong Kong. With our ongoing expansions into Saudi Arabia, Keeta achieved the remarkable feat of launching 5 cities in just 17 days, allowing the Arab world to witness the speed of China! Keeta offers exciting opportunities to join a transformative journey that is shaping the future of delivery and retail. Join Keeta, explore the world.


What You'll Do


  • Responsible for the development and operation of regional chain brands, driving user acquisition and scale growth for assigned brands, leading the team to execute the company's sales strategies, and achieving performance targets;
  • Promote deep collaboration between regional chain brands and the platform in areas such as brand marketing, promotional activities, and user operations, enhancing the partnership and stickiness between the brands and Keeta;
  • Based on the characteristics of the food and beverage industry, develop a deep understanding of categories and brand operation models, identify business development opportunities, and formulate tactical plans covering (but not limited to) growth, marketing, user experience, and membership programs to strengthen Keeta’s influence within the industry;
  • Establish strong communication with the delivery department, acting as a bridge between brands and the platform’s delivery operations, and work collaboratively to continuously optimize the brand delivery service experience;
  • Fully leverage personal work potential, gather frontline marketing information, user feedback, and local market dynamics to provide valuable insights and references for the company's decision-making.


What We Need From You


  • Solid experience in key account management, channel development, or retail management, with a solid foundation in management methodologies and practices.
  • Strong business negotiation and market expansion skills, with a keen ability to identify client and user needs and a proactive attitude toward challenges.
  • Experienced in process and project management, with the ability to drive multiple tasks and projects concurrently.
  • Highly reliable and resilient, demonstrating strong work enthusiasm and a collaborative team spirit.
  • Fluent in English (speaking, reading, and writing) and capable of using it as a working language; proficiency in Portuguese is a strong plus.


Why Join Keeta

Keeta is redefining the future of food delivery with a clear vision and innovative spirit. As a fast-scaling brand under Meituan's global ambition, we offer a unique blend of stability and startup energy, providing boundless opportunities for personal and professional growth. Whether you want to specialize in your field or gain cross-functional experience, Keeta empowers you to take charge of your career.

As we expand globally, we are committed to building a workplace that reflects our unique culture while incorporating global best practices. You'll be part of a company that's transforming the delivery industry while supporting local communities, empowering merchants, and delivering outstanding customer experiences.

At Keeta, you'll collaborate with a passionate and pragmatic global team across over 94 countries, bringing diverse perspectives that drive creativity and innovation. We believe diversity is our strength and it pushes us to deliver better solutions for our customers and partners in Hong Kong, Saudi Arabia, and beyond.

Keeta offers limitless career growth and equal development opportunities, empowering you to grow as the company grows. Every day presents an opportunity for you to make a meaningful impact, grow professionally, and be part of something extraordinary. You'll thrive in a dynamic environment where every contribution is valued. Together, let's build the future of food delivery.

description:
JOB REQUIREMENTS

The purpose of a cost analyst's work is to contribute to improving the profitability and efficiency of the company's internal processes. This is done through cost analysis and control, budget preparation, and the creation of cost restructuring, cutting, or reduction programs.


Educational Qualifications

Experience :

  • Prior knowledge or experience with Industrial Costing is desirable.
  • Experience with the TOTVS system is desirable, including BOM analysis, data entry, inventory, raw material reconciliation, cost analysis and budgeting, and understanding of finished product cost closing.


Industry specification : Automotive


KEY COMPETENCIES

Technical /


  • Knowledge: Fixed and variable costs.

2. Experience with Average Cost and GGF analysis.

3. Knowledge of inventory reconciliation and accounting.

4. Preparation of closing and management reports.

5. Knowledge of Microsoft Office suite.

6. Knowledge of Brazilian accounting standards.

7. Certifications in finance, controlling, or cost accounting are desirable.

8. Organization and time management skills, with the ability to handle multiple projects

simultaneously.

3. Analytical and problem-solving skills

4. Proactivity and focus on results

5. Teamwork and good adaptability to change.

6. Interpersonal Communication

7. Flexibility


ACTIVITIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Packlist vs. Structure Analysis;

2. Cost analysis by invoice and accounting integration;

3. Monitoring inventory movement;

4. Consumption Conference vs. Appointment;

5. Cost consolidation by Import Document;

6. Monthly reconciliation of cost by part number and variances;

7. To analyze, with a critical eye, the expenses generated by the company;

8. Plan cost reduction;

9. Conduct monthly inventory counts together with the stockroom staff;

10. Monitor inventory and purchase balances monthly;

11. Compiling financial data reports to aid decision-making;

12. To monitor significant variations in expenses;

13. Implement and maintain costing systems;

14. To support strategic decision-making based on financial data;

title: Bookkeeper
description:
Bookkeeper / Accounting & ERP Specialist (Odoo)

Remote (Latin America) supporting a U.S.-based company in California


Please watch this two-minute video first:

Presentation of the job:

Compensation: $2,200 to $2,500 USD per month (based on experience)

Schedule: Full time / 8 hours per day


Must-Haves

  • Based in Latin America
  • Fluent English (written & spoken)
  • 3+ years experience in bookkeeping

About Heart Medical

Heart Medical is a U.S.-based medical business in Carlsbad, California. This role will support U.S. operations by keeping accounting records accurate, current, and reliable inside Odoo ERP.


Role Summary

Heart Medical is seeking a highly organized, detail-driven Bookkeeper / Accounting & ERP Specialist to manage daily accounting operations and maintain accurate financial reporting within Odoo ERP. You will own day-to-day bookkeeping, ensure accounts are reconciled daily, support AP/AR, maintain inventory valuation accuracy, and help keep reporting clean across departments (service, sales, refurbishment).

This is a hybrid role combining bookkeeping plus general administrative support as needed.


Key Responsibilities

Daily Reconciliation and Cash Control (Critical)

  • Reconcile all company bank accounts daily (to the business day).
  • Reconcile all company credit card accounts daily, ensuring transactions are coded correctly.
  • Ensure cash balances in Odoo match actual bank balances at all times.
  • Identify discrepancies immediately and resolve them the same day whenever possible.
  • Maintain clean documentation for all reconciliations and adjustments.

Credit Card Management and Expense Reporting

  • Manage and reconcile corporate credit card activity.
  • Collect, review, and process employee expense reports (receipts, policy compliance, correct coding and departmental allocation).
  • Flag questionable or out-of-policy spending to leadership.
  • Post expense activity promptly and accurately in Odoo.

Accounts Payable (AP)

  • Enter, code, and manage vendor bills in Odoo accurately.
  • Prioritize AP based on vendor terms, critical supply needs, and cash flow planning.
  • Ensure payments are made on time to avoid late fees and supply disruptions.
  • Maintain vendor records and resolve billing discrepancies.
  • Monitor open POs and ensure matching between bills, POs, and receipts.

Accounts Receivable (AR)

  • Track AR aging and follow up consistently.
  • Send reminders and follow up on overdue invoices.
  • Apply customer payments correctly and promptly in Odoo.
  • Coordinate with operations/sales to resolve disputes and billing issues.
  • Escalate problem accounts to leadership.

Inventory Valuation and Landed Cost Accounting

  • Maintain accurate inventory valuation.
  • Perform landed cost calculations and allocation (freight, duties, handling, inbound costs).
  • Reconcile inventory sub-ledgers to the general ledger.
  • Support physical inventory counts and investigate variances.
  • Identify and correct issues (negative inventory, miscoded items, incorrect product setup).

Odoo ERP Department Setup and Cost Structure

  • Create and maintain departments/cost centers in Odoo (Service, Sales, Refurbishment).
  • Ensure COGS is categorized correctly for clean margin reporting and profitability by department.

Asset Tracking and Fixed Asset Management

  • Maintain fixed asset records in Odoo (capitalization vs expense, depreciation, transfers, disposals).
  • Ensure schedules align with the general ledger and maintain documentation.

Budgeting and Reporting (Odoo-based)

  • Build and maintain budgets in Odoo, including departmental budgets.
  • Track actuals vs budget and provide variance reporting.
  • Support forecasting and cash planning with accurate inputs.

Sales Order and Purchase Order Support

  • Process sales orders accurately (pricing, tax treatment, inventory deduction, revenue and COGS posting).
  • Follow up on outstanding purchase orders with vendors and internal teams.
  • Keep workflows clean and correctly reflected in Odoo.

General Administrative Support (as needed)

  • Provide light operational/admin support that helps the team run smoothly (coordination, documentation, basic tracking), depending on weekly workload.


Performance Expectations

  • Books are fully reconciled daily with no backlog.
  • Financial records are audit-ready at any time.
  • Inventory valuation is accurate and aligned with operational reality.
  • AP/AR is actively managed with minimal overdue balances.
  • Leadership can trust Odoo reports without manual correction or guesswork.


Required Skills and Qualifications

  • 3+ years experience in bookkeeping or accounting operations (distribution, medical, or equipment-based business preferred).
  • Strong working knowledge of bank and credit card reconciliations, AP/AR, inventory accounting and valuation, landed cost, budgeting, and departmental reporting.
  • Odoo ERP proficiency strongly preferred (or proven ability to learn quickly).
  • Strong Excel/spreadsheet skills.
  • High attention to detail, strong organization, and ability to work independently.
  • Strong English communication and ability to coordinate with sales, operations, and leadership.

Preferred (Bonus)

  • Medical device distribution, equipment refurbishment, or service-based inventory experience.
  • Familiarity with inventory costing methods (FIFO/average cost) and COGS structure.
  • Experience implementing internal controls and SOPs.
  • Experience working with CPA firms during month-end and tax prep.


Additional Details

Schedule: Ideally 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Pacific Time (PT/PST). Candidates located a few hours ahead of PT are welcome.

Holidays: Observes U.S. holidays

PTO: 1 week of PTO per year

Contract Type: Independent contractor (you will be responsible for your own taxes and benefits).

Equipment: You need to provide your own computer equipment and internet.

Application Process

  • Once you apply, you'll receive a 26-minute TestGorilla assessment to evaluate your problem-solving skills
  • If you score well, I'll invite you to a video interview, and afterward we'll share personalized feedback from the conversation
  • After the interview, you'll complete a take-home practical exercise
  • Final step: You'll meet with the Hiring Manager

  • Definir, em conjunto com o gestor da área, padrões de produtividade, qualidade e prazos, garantindo eficiência e padronização das entregas do Departamento.
  • Monitorar cronogramas de aprovações, antecipando riscos e propondo ações corretivas para evitar impactos no prazo de implantação dos empreendimentos.

O que esperamos que você tenha:

title: PL / SR HR Analyst
description:
Opportunity | PL/SR HR Analyst (Payroll & Benefits) | São Paulo – SP


A leading multinational company in the renewable energy sector is seeking an experienced and detail-oriented HR Analyst (Payroll & Benefits) to join its Brazil operations. This role is ideal for a professional with a strong payroll background and a generalist HR mindset who thrives in a fast-paced, international environment.

This position plays a key role in ensuring payroll accuracy, compliance with Brazilian labor legislation, operational excellence in HR processes, and effective partnership with local and global stakeholders. The selected professional will have frequent interaction with international teams, contributing to both local operations and global HR initiatives.


Key Responsibilities:

• Lead and coordinate the full payroll cycle, partnering with external payroll providers and the Finance department to ensure accuracy, compliance, and timely processing

• Review payroll reports, validate data, and support audits and internal controls

• Manage and continuously improve employee benefits administration

• Create and manage HR-related purchase orders, invoice reconciliation, and vendor interactions

• Partner closely with the Legal department on labor matters, employee relations issues, and union interactions

• Provide guidance to managers on employee relations, performance concerns, and people-related decisions aligned with business goals and labor legislation

• Oversee onboarding and offboarding processes, including documentation, compliance procedures, and exit interviews

• Maintain and manage HR systems (TOTVS preferred), ensuring data integrity and reporting accuracy

• Develop, monitor, and analyze HR metrics and dashboards using Power BI to support data-driven decision-making

• Support recruitment processes and participate in global HR projects and cross-functional initiatives

• Contribute to the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of HR policies and procedures


What We’re Looking For:

• Solid experience managing end-to-end payroll processes in Brazil

• Strong knowledge of Brazilian labor legislation and compliance practices

• Generalist HR experience with a structured, analytical, and solution-oriented mindset

• Advanced English (mandatory) – daily interaction with global stakeholders

• Spanish is a plus

• Experience with TOTVS is an advantage

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office 365 (especially Excel)

• Bachelor’s degree in Administration, Psychology, Economics, or related fields


Location: Vila Olímpia – São Paulo/SP

Employment Type: Full-time (CLT) | On-site


Competitive compensation aligned with experience + comprehensive benefits package


Opportunity to grow within a dynamic and expanding global organization in the renewable energy industry


Interested candidates, please submit your CV in English.

Fundada no Brasil em 2020, com sede em São Paulo, a Gruen conta com um time de engenharia atuando tanto localmente quanto na Alemanha o que assegura o desenvolvimento do processo mais eficiente para cada projeto. Nossa missão é entregar a melhor tecnologia para purificação de biogás com o menor consumo de energia entre todos os processos disponíveis no mercado.

Fabricação e assistência técnica locais resultam em redução de custo e aumento de eficiência.

Soluções para contratos de manutenção e operação das plantas viabilizam a redução da complexidade e de custos.

title: PESSOA COORDENADORA SEGURANÇA DA INFORMAÇÃO
description:
O Grupo Petrópolis é a única grande empresa do setor cervejeiro com capital 100% nacional. Produz as marcas de cerveja Itaipava, Cabaré, Crystal, Lokal, Black Princess, Petra e Weltenburger, Brassaria Ampolis com os rótulos Cacildis, Biritis, Ditriguis e Forévis, as vodkas Blue Spirit Ice e Nordka, a Cabaré Ice, os energéticos TNT Energy Drink e Magneto, o refrigerante It!, o isotônico TNT Sports Drink e a água Petra.


Com oito fábricas em operação e aproximadamente 160 centros de distribuição, o grupo é responsável pela geração de aproximadamente 22 mil empregos diretos. Por meio dos projetos ambientais, promove o plantio e manutenção de milhares de árvores, além de ações de sustentabilidade e programa de educação ambiental para escolas municipais. Conta também com o Saber Beber, programa comprometido em orientar as pessoas sobre os benefícios do consumo moderado e as consequências do consumo exagerado de álcool.


O respeito é um dos valores do Grupo Petrópolis, e por isso todas as crenças, identidades culturais, gêneros, idades, raças, opções individuais e pessoas com deficiência são respeitadas e valorizadas. Para todas as nossas vagas consideramos candidatos representados por esta ampla diversidade.



Objetivo:

Responsável pelo acompanhamento, controle e execução das atividades segurança da informação, disponibilizando ferramentas e auditando a utilização da mesma bem como assegurando, visando garantir a confidencialidade, integridade e disponibilidade dos sistemas e plataformas da empresa, dos parceiros e clientes, aumentando a eficiência operacional de forma segura, em conformidade com as normas e procedimentos da empresa. Criar filas de atendimentos e orientar o time a colocar o cliente no centro, priorizando o atendimento e a satisfação do cliente, sem deixar de seguir as regras de negócios e critérios de liberação de acesso. Auditar os acessos de administrador visando maior segurança e garantir a disponibilidade das ferramentas que liberam os acessos.


Atividades:

  • Coordenar equipe multidisciplinar para demandas de gestão de acesso e GRC SAP, atendimento de chamados e demandas de Segurança da Informação, sendo Blue e Red Team, garantindo o atendimento dentro dos prazos acordados, colocando o cliente no centro, priorizando a qualidade, agilidade e segurança nas liberações de acesso aos ambientes, ferramentas e sistemas do grupo.
  • Garantir a aplicação de princípios de segurança da informação, por meio da avaliação dos processos de tecnologia da informação.
  • Gerenciamento de vulnerabilidades, Firewall, IPS, Antivírus, EDR, AntiSpam, SIEM, WAF, Filtro de conteúdo Web, Cofre de Senha, HoneyPot, Threat Intelligence, Segurança em Nuvem, Forense, liberação de acesso para auditoria de Compliance e novas tecnologias.
  • Atuar na garantia da segurança de dados do ERP SAP e SAP HANA Cloud, validando a robustez do ambiente nativo e providenciando um ambiente protegido contra ameaças.
  • Conhecer arquitetura de centralização de repositórios de armazenamento, protegendo grandes quantidade de dados processados dos tipos estruturados, semiestruturados e desestruturados, Data Lake, para que seja possível prover segurança ao ambiente.
  • Proteger o ambiente tecnológico por meio do entendimento e aplicação de conceitos e metodologias de modelagem de ameaças cibernéticas.
  • Promover, sistematicamente, melhoria contínua, através da consolidação, monitoramento e análise dos indicadores de performance de segurança, bem como da elaboração de planos de ação, também é necessário criar indicadores de performance e monitoramento do ambiente.



Requisitos Mínimos:


  • Pós Graduação: Gestão de Segurança da Informação / Governança de TI / Gestão de Projetos / Sistemas de informação / Ciência da Computação
  • Conhecimentos e atuação nos conceitos/processos de segurança da informação:
  • OWASP, NIST, CIS, ISO27000;
  • Certificações desejáveis: Cobit, ITIL, ISFS – Information Seurity Foundation ou ISO 27001, PDPF – Privacy & Data Protection Foundation, AWS Security, Azure Security, CISSP, CISM;
  • Experiencia em gestão de projetos de segurança da informação;
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de redes.

title: Géologo(a) de Exploração Junior
description:
Géologo(a) de Exploração Jr


Local: Riacho dos Machados, MG

Quantidade de Vagas: 01

Modelo de Trabalho: Presencial

Disponibilidade: Mudança para a região


Sobre a Oportunidade

Responder pela execução de trabalhos de natureza geológica, sondagens, amostragens, mapeamento, modelamento, estimativa e interpretações geológicas, englobando a conceituação inicial, desenvolvimento até a realização do projeto, mapeamento geológico e amostragem (subsolo e superfície), contribuindo para avaliação do potencial aurífero das áreas, para as operações de extração e que resultem na expansão da reserva mineral e manutenção dos alvarás de pesquisa e lavra concedidos.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Executar atividades de mapeamento e amostragens relacionadas a programas de pesquisa mineral e liderar tecnicamente as equipes das diversas frentes de trabalho da área de Geologia, buscando a otimização e produtividade durante a execução dos procedimentos de rotina e a boa interação com as demais áreas da empresa;
  • Controlar e acompanhar a produção de sondagem com foco no QAQC, garantindo a acuidade e qualidade da informação, de acordo com os procedimentos internos e normas de segurança, visando o atendimento às demandas da área.
  • Descrição dos Log´s de sondagem: litologias, estruturas, alteração hidrotermal e mineralizações, a fim de garantir a qualidade da informação que será utilizada nos processos subsequentes da cadeia de exploração mineral.
  • Gerar mapas e seções multitemáticas, as quais constituem itens essenciais na caracterização e avaliação das áreas de pesquisa/frentes de lavra, visando à confiabilidade dos resultados e o atendimento aos padrões de qualidade definidos pela Empresa.
  • Orientar e acompanhar os trabalhos de pesquisa mineral junto ao corpo técnico (técnicos e auxiliares), a fim de que os procedimentos, organização e qualidade da informação estejam de acordo com as melhores práticas do mercado.
  • Executar e coordenar o desenvolvimento dos protocolos e sistemas de garantia de qualidade/controle de qualidade para todos os dados de exploração, visando a utilização da informação nos processos subsequentes de modelamento e estimativa de recursos/reservas
  • Inserção e controle de informações no banco de dados, garantindo a organização e qualidade da informação, visando à confiabilidade dos resultados e o atendimento aos padrões de qualidade definidos pela Empresa.
  • Preparar relatórios, conforme necessário, sobre dados geológicos, modelos, parâmetros e riscos técnicos relacionados a pesquisa mineral e relatórios normativos, em atendimento a protocolos/exigências de órgão públicos/privados.
  • Colaborar para manter todos os conjuntos de dados de uma maneira eficiente, enquanto constrói e mantém um banco de dados para uso por vários departamentos e usuários, a fim de mantê-lo organizado e auditável (interna e externamente), visando à confiabilidade dos resultados e o atendimento aos padrões de qualidade definidos pela Empresa.
  • Participar de auditorias técnicas, resumir as informações e se comunicar com os principais líderes, visando garantir a acuracidade e qualidade da informação e sua utilização nas etapas subsequentes de estimativa.
  • Permanecer atualizado em campos de interesse - bancos de dados e sistemas de gerenciamento de banco de dados, GIS, softwares de modelamento, garantindo a qualidade da informação, visando à confiabilidade dos resultados e o atendimento aos padrões de qualidade definidos pela Empresa.


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Formação Superior em Geologia;
  • Pacote Office;
  • Conhecimento em softwares de Geologia (Leapfrog, ArcGis, Datamine);
  • Inglês Intermediário.

title: Mid/Senior Devops
description:
Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.


Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.


We are looking for a DevOps Engineer to join a strategic cloud migration initiative, transitioning workloads from Azure to AWS within a structured modernization program.

This professional will play a key role in supporting the technical execution of the migration, ensuring infrastructure standardization, automation, CI/CD pipeline implementation, environment readiness, observability, and post-migration operational validation.


The project follows a Lift & Shift / Replatform approach, covering infrastructure preparation, security, networking, service equivalency mapping, migration execution, testing, stabilization, and post-cutover operational readiness.


Key Responsibilities


  • Prepare and standardize AWS environments (VPC, IAM, networking, security, logging).
  • Support migrations using AWS MGN, DMS, and SCT.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines.
  • Manage Infrastructure as Code with Terraform.
  • Implement monitoring and observability (CloudWatch, X-Ray, Grafana).
  • Validate application, database, and network functionality post-migration.
  • Support performance, scalability, and security testing.
  • Contribute to documentation and runbooks.


What do you need to know?

title: Lead Learning Designer
description:
About BrainBuffet

BrainBuffet is an EdTech curriculum production company focused on creating certification-aligned learning experiences that prepare students for real-world careers. We design high-quality courses and resources for industry certifications such as Adobe, Microsoft, Unity, Cisco, and Intuit, combining strong instructional design, hands-on learning, and practical skill development. Our mission is to empower educators and students through engaging, accessible, and effective digital learning that builds creativity, confidence, and career-ready skills. Learn more at

About the Role

We’re looking for a Lead Learning Designer to own the pre-production and instructional design strategy of our certification courses. This role sits at the intersection of pedagogy, content strategy, and cross-functional collaboration.

You’ll be responsible for shaping courses from the ground up—working closely with the Product Manager, the Creative Director, Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), the Project Manager, and Curriculum Consultants to ensure every course is accurate, well-structured, and aligned with certification requirements.

This is a leadership role that requires strong instructional design expertise, systems thinking, and the ability to guide both internal teams and external partners.

Requirements
  • Strong background in instructional design, curriculum development, or learning experience design.
  • Proven experience designing structured courses with clear learning objectives and measurable outcomes.
  • Professional proficiency in spoken and written English.
  • Excellent organizational skills and strong attention to detail.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills across cross-functional teams.
  • Experience working with subject-matter experts (SMEs) to develop accurate, instructionally sound content.
  • Ability to manage complex workflows and own instructional pre-production from planning through production readiness.
  • Demonstrated leadership experience, including mentoring instructional designers, setting quality standards, and providing clear feedback.
  • Ability to guide, prioritize, and align the education design team, ensuring consistency, scalability, and high instructional quality across courses.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Previous experience in EdTech, digital learning, or curriculum production environments.
  • Experience creating instructional blueprints, scripts, templates, and structured course frameworks.
  • Experience collaborating with creative and production teams in video-based learning environments.
  • Familiarity with technical subject matter such as creative software, IT, business, or certification pathways.
  • Experience designing certification-aligned or standards-aligned courses.
Key Responsibilities Exam & Content Analysis
  • Analyze certification objective domains to understand the exam structure, and to gather the knowledge students will need to succeed.
  • Translate exam requirements into effective learning strategies and course structure.
Course Ideation & Strategy
  • Collaborate with Product Managers, Creative Directors, and Consultants to support course ideation and development.
  • Conduct desk research to understand the topic area, target audience, industry trends, key players, opportunities, and challenges.
  • Participate in stakeholder handoffs and ensure alignment from concept to execution.
Partner Selection & Onboarding
  • Support the selection and onboarding of external partners:
  • Curriculum Consultants (subject-matter experts who validate content accuracy)
  • Instructors / SMEs (on-camera educators who record course content)
  • Review instructor samples to ensure teaching style, clarity, and tone align with BrainBuffet standards.
  • Lead onboarding for SMEs and contributors by sharing guidelines, templates, workflows, and quality expectations.
Pre Production Ownership

You are accountable for instructional pre-production and content structure , ensuring all educational components are clearly defined and prepared before production begins:

  • Partner with Consultants and the Creative Director to draft and refine the course outline.
  • Define the instructional structure, scope, and sequence to ensure alignment with learning objectives and product goals.
  • Develop or approve instructional guidelines, templates, scripts, and blueprints for:
  • Video content
  • Written materials (worksheets, quizzes, lesson plans, and supporting resources)
  • Collaborate with the Creative Director to ensure instructional plans align with creative vision and production approach.
  • Review early instructional drafts with Education, Editing, and Creative teams, incorporating feedback as appropriate.
  • Ensure instructional accuracy and pedagogical integrity in collaboration with Consultants and SMEs.
  • Provide instructional input on video samples and early production materials in partnership with the Creative Director.
Content Review & Quality Control
  • Review and refine instructional scripts and recorded videos, providing actionable feedback to instructors and clear notes for the editing team (cuts, cleanup, and improvements).
  • Guide the team in reviewing the instructional structure of written deliverables (including quizzes, video pop-up questions, endcards), ensuring alignment with the course blueprint and supporting consistency, clarity, and pedagogical integrity.
  • Review and approve written deliverables, including quizzes, worksheets, handbooks, activities, and lesson plans.
  • Review and approve SME deliverables, cleanup runs, and ensure alignment with established standards and workflows across modules and videos.
  • Maintain accurate project documentation and status updates throughout the production process.
Collaboration & Leadership
  • Create and maintain course syllabi that define structure, scope, and instructional direction for each course.
  • Train and mentor new Learning Designers and Learning Experience Designers.
  • Lead and support the education team, fostering collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  • Act as the main point of contact for SMEs and Consultants regarding content, pedagogy, and educational practices.
Why Join BrainBuffet <3
  • Help shape learning experiences that directly prepare students for careers.
  • Collaborate with a passionate, cross-disciplinary team.
  • Work on impactful, industry-recognized certification courses.
  • Fully remote and collaborative work environment.
